summary: Every save now goes through the server, and saving default number formats in Preferences works again.
details: A save the server cannot take yet says the server needs updating, and a PC that is not signed in is asked to sign in, instead of writing to the shared drive.
Default number formats are saved on the server and record who saved them; a save that lists dataset type formats no longer fails.
The Dataset Viewer's reserving class list now shows the classes the project's data holds.
